name: Daniela Amodei
person: Daniela Amodei, Co-founder & President of Anthropic (founded 2021), running operations, business, finance, legal, policy, and communications. Before Anthropic she worked at OpenAI in operations/safety roles, and before that spent several years at Stripe leading risk operations, and earlier in the humanitarian/human-rights sector (including at the US Department of the Treasury on human trafficking policy). Sister of Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei; co-founded the company with him and several ex-OpenAI colleagues. Known for a management/operations-focused public voice rather than technical research output, interviews on scaling a values-driven AI company, hiring philosophy, and the operational side of running a frontier AI lab. NOT her brother Dario Amodei (a separate advisor) or any unrelated Daniela Amodei.

notes.attribution: Do not confuse her with her brother, Dario Amodei (Anthropic CEO), who has a separate dossier.

enumPrompts.label: entrevistas-primarias
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate LONG-FORM INTERVIEWS and PANEL APPEARANCES featuring {{PERSON}}, President and co-founder of Anthropic.
Specifically look for and verify these known leads, plus find any others:
1. Sixth Street podcast appearance (~May 2026).
2. Future of Life Institute panel/interview alongside her brother Dario Amodei (~2023), possibly transcribed on LessWrong or the Future of Life Institute site.
3. Notion "First Block" interview series (~2023).
4. Stanford GSB "View From the Top" talk (~May 2026).
5. Grit Podcast episode #177 (~Feb 2024).
6. Fortune interview (~Feb 2026) about hiring/humanities backgrounds at Anthropic.
Return exact URLs (verify each lead actually exists and get the real URL, do not guess), priority=high for anything with substantial first-person content, one-line "why" per item.

enumPrompts.label: outras-fontes
enumPrompts.prompt: Enumerate any OTHER primary material, essays, company blog posts, or additional interviews/podcasts, where {{PERSON}} speaks in her own voice about: Anthropic's founding story and the decision to leave OpenAI, operational/hiring philosophy at Anthropic, running a "safety-focused" company at commercial scale, or her views on AI policy/regulation from an operations (not research) angle. Also check for any co-authored Anthropic company statements or letters where she is a named voice. Return exact URLs, priority-marked, one-line "why" per item.

enumPrompts.label: criticas
enumPrompts.prompt:
